claim_boundaries: This layer is a budget/verifier router, not a task-world simulator.
No recommendation can auto-accept a proposal, auto-apply a graph policy change, or replace live judge evidence.
The B3 gate is evaluated on leave-pattern split discipline and a synthetic low-support stress probe.
validation_scope: Adds confidence intervals, calibration bins, abstention reasons, and verifier-tier routing to the B2 feature simulator.  The simulator can route candidates to ablation, evidence collection, repair, or live validation, but cannot auto-accept, auto-apply, or replace judge evidence.
